description: Molecular and Stable Isotopic (2H/1H AND 13C/12C) Compositions of Natural Gas from the Exmouth Plateau, Carnarvon Basin is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. This study documents the natural gas compositions of accumulations on the Exmouth Plateau and adjacent Rankin Platform in the Carnarvon Basin, a proven super-giant gas province on the North West Shelf of offshore Western Australia. The Exmouth Plateau contains Australia's largest undeveloped gas resources. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data.
